description: This Java class defines a custom Liquibase task for disabling triggers on all tables within a database schema. It implements the CustomTaskChange interface to execute raw SQL commands to disable triggers on each table retrieved via database metadata.

classes.name: DisableTriggersChangeSet
classes.description: A custom Liquibase task class that disables all triggers on all tables in the current database schema by iterating over table metadata and executing ALTER TABLE statements.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main action of disabling triggers on all tables by querying table metadata and executing ALTER TABLE commands.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating completion of the trigger disabling process.

methods.description: Empty setup function as part of the interface implementation.

methods.description: Empty method for resource accessor setup, required by interface.

methods.description: Validates the database configuration; returns an empty ValidationErrors object.
